description: This Java class defines a REST API controller for accessing product data within the catalog service of the application. It provides an endpoint to list all active products, returning a list of product summaries. The class uses Spring annotations for defining REST endpoints and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: REST controller providing product-related API endpoints, specifically for listing active products.

methods.name: listActiveProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all active products, returning a list of ProductSummaryDto objects.
